name: Dieselpunk

influenced_by: a term coined by analogy with steampunk (2001, game designer Lewis Pollak)

reacts_against: steampunk's Victorian steam-power setting, imagining an alternate 1920s-40s built on oil, diesel and heavy industry instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Diesel-powered machinery, riveted surfaces, engine turning, aviation, vacuum tubes, Art Deco, Streamline Moderne, propaganda art, pulp fiction
wiki_facts.key_colours: Black, grey, muted industrial tones, metallic shades

wiki_facts.key_values: Technological advancement, societal change, war, rebellion, dystopia, utopia, human-machine interaction, noir elements

findings: dark — about 48% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 79% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
